datasets.name: Zarkada GSE175895

environment_observed_in_validated_execut.limitation: Exact scikit-learn, matplotlib, leidenalg, and igraph versions were not captured; requirements bound compatible APIs and notebook assertions detect analytical drift.

caveats: Individual cells are not independent biological replicates.
MRCA sequencing/preparation cohorts are not equivalent to 11 independent animals.
Furtado genotype libraries are pooled preparations; comparisons are descriptive.
Zarkada state contrasts are descriptive and have unequal cell counts.
The smallest Alk5 E7 D-tip/S-tip comparison is supportive rather than independently decisive.
Module scores represent transcriptional identity and do not directly measure pathway activity or causality.
